title: Tribe Lead Insurance - Private Individuals
full_description:
Hybrid mode – possibility of 50% work from home based on team agreements
GJA Function Level: GJA21
Insurance plays a critical role in the financial well-being of both private individuals and businesses. Customers expect integrated solutions that go beyond traditional banking—solutions that protect their assets, secure their future, and provide peace of mind. For individuals, insurance complements daily banking, mortgages, savings & investment products, ensuring financial resilience against life’s uncertainties. For businesses, it safeguards operations, employees, and growth ambitions, making it an essential component of risk management.
As part of ING Belgium’s strategy, insurance is not just an add-on—it is a core element of our value proposition. By embedding insurance into our banking ecosystem, we create holistic financial journeys that strengthen customer trust, deepen relationships, and drive sustainable growth. This strategic focus positions ING as a partner that delivers security and confidence alongside innovative financial solutions.As Tribe Lead Insurance, you will lead the strategy and execution of insurance solutions for ING’s private and business clients in Belgium, ensuring they are relevant, digital-first, and seamlessly integrated into our customer journeys.You will be the effective leader for insurance in Belgium, reporting hierarchically to the Head of Private Individuals Belgium, and being part of the Management team of Private Individuals.You will collaborate with your teams, local and global stakeholders, and strategic partners (AXA, NN) to deliver innovative propositions and drive digital transformation in the insurance domain.
